# Bun fullstack base

> A Void app on Bun: file routes for the API (Hono, validated by Zod) and server-rendered React pages, on one server,
> with SQLite through Drizzle.

## API

- [Greeting](/api/hello/world): `GET /api/hello/{name}`, a greeting for a name
- [Notes](/api/notes): `GET /api/notes`, a page of notes, newest first (`?limit=20&before=` a page's `next`), `POST /api/notes` with `{ "text" }` to add one, `PATCH /api/notes/{id}` to change one, and `DELETE /api/notes/{id}` to delete one
- [Health](/api/health): `GET /api/health`, whether the API is up
